title: Data-Driven LQR with Uncertainty Refinement and Domain Randomization---Part~II: Fisher-Majorized Certified Policy Iteration
title_zh: 数据驱动的LQR：不确定性精炼与域随机化——第二部分：Fisher主控的认证策略迭代
abstract: Building on the uncertainty description developed in Part~I, this paper introduces a Fisher-majorized domain-randomized generalized policy iteration framework for data-driven linear quadratic regulator (LQR) synthesis. At each iteration, partial Bellman evaluation over a fixed batch of uncertainty realizations produces a structured Sylvester policy-improvement step. A residual-weighted Fisher curvature controls the policy-induced variation in the stationary covariance and converts the Sylvester model into a certified upper bound on the cost change, thereby guaranteeing descent for every accepted step. A check-and-correct mechanism then certifies stability over the entire uncertainty support, rather than only over the sampled realizations. Consequently, every iterate is robustly stabilizing and monotonically decreases the fixed-batch objective. The Fisher truncation and stability correction become inactive after finitely many times. The objective gap then contracts linearly to a floor determined by the dispersion of the realization-wise Riccati targets and by measurement noise. In the absence of measurement noise, this floor vanishes when the realization-wise targets coincide.
abstract_zh: 在Part I所建立的不确定性描述基础上，本文提出了一种Fisher主控的域随机化广义策略迭代框架，用于数据驱动的线性二次调节器（LQR）综合。在每次迭代中，对固定批次的不确定性实现进行部分Bellman评估，产生一个结构化的Sylvester策略改进步骤。残差加权的Fisher曲率控制策略引起的平稳协方差变化，并将Sylvester模型转化为成本变化的认证上界，从而保证每个被接受的步骤都下降。然后，一种检查-校正机制在整个不确定性支撑集上认证稳定性，而不仅仅是在采样实现上。因此，每个迭代点都是鲁棒稳定的，并且单调地降低固定批次目标。Fisher截断和稳定性校正经过有限次后不再激活。目标差距随后线性收缩到一个由实现级Riccati目标的离散度和测量噪声决定的下限。在没有测量噪声的情况下，当实现级目标一致时，该下限消失。
tldr_zh: 提出Fisher主控策略迭代，保证LQR鲁棒稳定且目标单调下降。
cover_zh: LQR新框架：每次迭代都保证下降，还能认证稳定性！
